scope: Numeric-only 2..32-element variance/STDEV calls. Original input bits preserved. Nonzero input magnitudes 2^-400..2^400. Finite nonnegative normal-or-zero expected outcomes. Unsupported and unread observations remain failed obligations, outside this grammar.

tier1: Original Excel corpus captures and existing witness judge traces
Defining variance identities; IEEE754 nearest-even arithmetic
Chan, Golub and LeVeque, Algorithms for Computing the Sample Variance: Analysis and Recommendations (1983), DOI 10.1080/00031305.1983.10483115; equations only
tier2: Current cleared DnaCalc arithmetic and existing research evaluator

grammar.shared_regions: Every execution of a region uses one fixed policy; dead labels retained. No data-dependent selector, cutoff or fitted constant.
grammar.publication: single final binary64 store, existing product zero/nonfinite/subnormal policy

exposure: All corpus and old bank observations are discovery. No new Excel readings. No blind validation claim.
limits: No data-dependent algorithm switch; especially no removed 1% selector
No arbitrary per-iteration stores, extra compensation, FMA or unlisted association
Elimination is per named function; no assumption that aliases share a private Excel body
Independent checker re-derives each program and every first contradiction with exact integer/rational arithmetic; reachability is not a producer
